title: CapabilityObject
description: The unit of learned capability. Generalises the Metis tacit-fragment tuple <content, provenance, conditions, confidence, authority, validation-state> to every kind of thing an agent can learn: prompt rules, loop policies, tool bindings, skills, eval cases, escalation rules, and references to governed memory fragments. A capability object never influences agent behaviour outside its authority layer, and never enters a signed release except through a recorded promotion decision.

content.description: The payload as canonical text. For structured kinds (loop_policy, eval_case, tool_binding) this is canonical JSON conforming to the matching payload sub-schema; for prompt_rule and escalation_rule it is the rule text itself; for memory_fragment it is empty and fragment_ref is required.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the JCS-canonicalised content. This is the identity that appears in capabilities.lock and in recall notices.

payload_schema.description: For structured kinds, the $id of the sub-schema the content conforms to.

fragment_ref.description: For kind=memory_fragment only: the Metis fragment_id this object binds into the agent. Metis remains the system of record; Brevet records the binding, its conditions, and its release lineage.

consent.description: Required when provenance includes human-derived material (overrides, whisper responses, worker traces). Shape follows the Metis tacit_consent_record schema.

lineage.description: Ordered refs: mining runs, CHAP envelope ids, prior capability versions, validation events, promotion records.

CapabilityKind.description: prompt_rule: an instruction added to the prompt architecture. loop_policy: a control-flow policy (loop type, budgets, verification steps) selected by conditions. tool_binding: a tool made available under the read/act contract. skill: a reusable executable routine. eval_case: a regression/rubric test, typically compiled from an override. escalation_rule: a condition under which the agent must hand off to a human. memory_fragment: a binding of a Metis-governed tacit fragment into this agent.

AuthorityLayer.description: evidence: may not influence behaviour or enter a release; exists for review. advisory: may enter a release; may shape suggest-class behaviour. controlled: may shape act-class behaviour; promotion requires change-control metadata and a Mission Group decision.

mined_by.description: Delta-engine run id or capture cell id.

source_traces.description: CHAP task/trace refs (enacted side of the delta).

source_overrides.description: CHAP decide.override envelope refs that labelled or corrected the behaviour.

specified_refs.description: Harness version / procedure refs (specified side of the delta).

ApplicabilityContext.description: Conditions are evaluated computationally BEFORE any similarity ranking (conditions-first retrieval). A capability whose conditions do not match is not weakened; it is withheld, and out-of-envelope near-matches escalate.

model_family.description: Capabilities are model-specific by default (harness edits rarely transfer across model families unexamined).
